newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares mark time, await coalition plan.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares mark time, await coalition plan.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 0.46 percent on Monday as investors stuck to the sidelines after Sunday's general election, waiting for clues on the composition of the country's next government.
"The market will stagnate until the next coalition is known," said Karmen Cerar, a trader at brokerage Poteza.

The ruling Liberal Democrats won 27.1 percent of the vote, but analysts expect they will have to form a coalition, possibly with one or two right-wing parties. The conservative People's Party came second with 19.6 percent.
* The SBI index fell 5.61 points to 1,218.9.
* Turnover fell to 205.4 million tolars from 392.7 million.
* Overall 10 shares fell, eight rose and one was unchanged, while five were untraded.
* Top decliner food producer Kolinska, down 3.7 percent at 2,020 tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
